title: Web UI exempt from agent-only governance gates
summary: Exempt Web UI supervisor calls from agent-only governance gates
description:
Bug fix: the feature/phase/task governance gate in packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts blocked ALL manual state changes from the Web UI, because the Web UI provides no way to satisfy the gate (no feature/phase discuss or contextReady action). The gate is meant for AGENT callers, not the human supervisor using the Web UI.

Root cause: 5 governance checks in serve.ts (feature PUT :356, phase POST :398, phase PUT :497, task POST :544, task PUT :722) return 400 when the parent feature/phase lacks discussedAt/contextReady. Every feature defaults contextReady=false, and the Web UI client has no path to set discussedAt/contextReady, so the gate permanently blocked UI state changes (user hit it as "feature governance required before starting task work" when setting a task in-progress).

Fix: identify Web UI calls via the X-Planner-Source: web-ui header (added to every fetch in packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts fetchOrThrow). serve.ts now skips the governance gate whenever that header is present (fromWebUi(c) helper). Agent-style calls (no header) remain gated. Verified end-to-end: PUT /tasks/:id without header -> 400, with header -> 200.

Files: packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts. No commit (pending user approval).

tasks.title: Exempt Web UI supervisor calls from feature/phase/task governance gates
tasks.description:
The governance gate in packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts (feature/phase/task discuss-before-work) blocked every manual state change from the Web UI, because the UI cannot satisfy it (no discussedAt/contextReady action) and every feature defaults contextReady=false.

Implementation:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts: fetchOrThrow now injects X-Planner-Source: web-ui on every request (merged with caller headers, so Content-Type still applies). This identifies Web UI (human supervisor) calls.
- packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts: added fromWebUi(c) helper (checks c.req.header("X-Planner-Source") === "web-ui") and added && !fromWebUi(c) to all 5 governance gates (feature PUT :356, phase POST :398, phase PUT :497, task POST :544, task PUT :722). Agent-style calls without the header stay gated.

Verification: spun up plan-server on a temp copy of .planner (planRoot = <tmp>/.planner) + dynamic port. PUT /tasks/:id to in-progress WITHOUT header -> 400 (gated), WITH X-Planner-Source: web-ui -> 200 (bypassed). Both plan-server and web-ui typecheck + build clean. No commit.
